snippet.title: Better Mart trailer🔥Download the game now 🎮
snippet.description:
🎉 It's with great joy that we announce the official release of Better Mart, our supermarket management game passionately developed by the Exanticx Studio team. After months of hard work, testing and feedback from our community, the game is ready to offer you a unique, immersive and strategic experience.

🔍 Try before you buy: a playable demo is available!
Immerse yourself in the world of supermarkets and find out if you have what it takes to be a real manager.

🙏 Thanks to our community!
This project would never have seen the light of day without your support. Your feedback, ideas and encouragement have been essential at every stage of development. This launch is as much yours as it is ours. 💙

🚀 This is just the beginning!
New content, new features and regular updates are already in the pipeline. Stay tuned!

Thank you all, and welcome to the world of Better Mart!

The Exanticx Studio team

📥 Download Better Mart on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3498270/Better_Mart/
Discord : / discord  
Website : https://exanticxstudio.com/

🔔 Don't forget to subscribe to keep up with the game!
